<function name="Publish" parent="WorkshopFileBase" type="classfunc">
	<description>
		Creates a <page>UGCPublishWindow</page> to publish the dupe or save
	</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="filename" type="string">The type to search for. (`local`, `subscribed`, `subscribed_ugc`, `mine`, `favorite`)</arg>
		<arg name="image" type="string">The image to use</arg>
	</args>
</function>
